evidence.title: Digital Realty Announces Purchase of Blackstone Interest in Three Northern Virginia Data Centers
evidence.excerpt: Digital Realty reports ongoing development and remaining completion capex for a 96 MW IT data center on its Digital Dulles campus in Sterling.
